title: Research on high specific strength as-cast AlxNbTiVZr high entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by nonconsumable arc melting using aluminium particles (99.9 wt.%), vanadium particles (99.9 wt.%), titanium sponge (99.9 wt.%), zirconium tablet (99.9 wt.%), and niobium foil (99.9 wt.%). All ingots were remelted at least six times to promote homogenisation.
